howto.name: Upload an image
howto.text: JPG, PNG, WebP up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Enter watermark text and styling
howto.text: Text, opacity (0-1), position (corners or center), font size.

howto.name: Download the watermarked image
howto.text: PrivaTools overlays the text at the chosen position with the chosen opacity. Original is unchanged.

faq.q: Can I watermark with an image instead of text?
faq.a: Currently text-only watermarks. Image watermarks (logo overlay) are on the roadmap.

Depends on placement. Watermarks over high-detail areas are harder to remove than over solid backgrounds. AI inpainting tools can sometimes erase them — for stronger protection, use diagonal repeating patterns.
Negligibly. Output is at the same JPEG quality as input.
